email.subject: Action required: unusual sign-in activity on your account
email.body_text:
Dear Customer,

We detected an unusual sign-in attempt on your Microsoft account from an unrecognised device in Lagos, Nigeria.

If this was not you, verify your account within 24 hours or your account will be suspended.

Verify now: https://micros0ft-login.com/verify?email=alex.morgan@contoso.com

Microsoft Account Team

label: PHISHING
notes: Homoglyph domain, brand display name, DMARC fail, credential lure, victim identity pre-filled.

email.subject: Your password expires today — action required
email.body_html:
Dear User,

Your Office 365 password expires in 4 hours. To keep your mailbox active you must re-authenticate immediately.

https://login.microsoftonline.com/

Failure to respond will result in loss of access.

label: PHISHING
notes: Anchor text shows login.microsoftonline.com, href goes elsewhere: display-vs-destination mismatch.

email.subject: Mandatory MFA re-enrolment before Friday
email.body_text:
All staff,

Due to a security upgrade, all users must re-enrol their multi-factor authentication before Friday. Accounts not re-enrolled will be locked.

label: PHISHING
notes: Spoofs the recipient's OWN domain (DMARC fail) and hides the real host in a subdomain prefix: contoso.com.<attacker>.xyz.

email.subject: Action needed: confirm your 2025 benefits election
